_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve phase_field#1: an unresolved interface width shows up as over/undershoot in c, and nothing in the solver reports it. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.1 (ne=230), P1, semi-implicit Allen-Cahn M=1 dt=1e-3 20 steps (2026-08-06): eps=0.002 (h/eps=50) gives c in (-0.2954, +1.2805) ~28% over/undershoot, eps=0.010 gives (-0.1586, +1.1273), eps=0.050 gives (-0.0000, +1.0000). Also records the FALSIFIED half of the claim: 'Newton did not converge after N iterations' is emitted nowhere by NGSolve 6.2.2604 (its wording is 'Warning: Newton might not converge! Error = '), and on this deliberately unresolved problem the fully implicit Newton converges with flag 0 in 3 iterations while c overshoots by 28%.
